trials.claim: Lifetime access to More Good Reviews Plan
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to More Good Reviews Plan
- All future More Good Reviews Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict lifetime access.

trials.claim: Each code limited to 5,000 monthly requests and 20 locations
trials.claimQuote: Each code comes with just 2 limitations: 5,000 monthly requests and 20 locations per account.
trials.reasoning: E1 is the vendor's regular pricing page showing per-location requests for ordinary customers, not the deal terms for code buyers. It does not show how deal accounts are actually metered.

exhibits.argument: Quote shows limit is per-location not per-account, so 5,000 total per code understates and misstates the actual metering structure.

trials.claim: 5 codes gives 100 locations for agency growth
trials.claimQuote: You get 100 locations (that's 100 single-location clients) to grow your agency.
trials.reasoning: E2 shows regular customers pay $12/month for extra locations, which is not evidence that deal buyers with 5 codes are charged for their 100 locations. No exhibit shows deal buyers being charged or denied those locations.

exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing shows extra locations cost $12/month each after included quota, contradicting claim that 100 locations are included for free agency growth.

trials.claim: All future More Good Reviews Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:
- All future More Good Reviews Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about whether future plan updates are included.

trials.claim: New resource-intensive features may require own API key or third-party service
trials.claimQuote: Yes. If a new feature is resource-intensive, we'll give you the option to add your own API key or connect a third-party service under your own account.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about API-key or third-party requirements for new features.
